children: Alphabet (GOOGL) will invest $17 billion in Wyoming for its first data center, acquiring a southeastern site from Crusoe. The campus will be developed with energy and infrastructure partners.
Alphabet’s five-year credit-default-swap spread hit a record in recent months, though it stayed below Oracle’s peak. Higher borrowing costs and delays monetizing AI spending pose risks.
Alphabet (GOOGL) launched Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, an AI model that generates and edits videos up to 15 seconds. Google cut 720p video generation costs 30% to $0.07 per second.
Alphabet (GOOGL) held nearly 3 million Qualcomm shares worth about $547.9 million as of September, after buying shares in Q3. It also raised its SpaceX stake to about 555 million shares.
Alphabet’s AI search summaries face criticism from Funke Media Group over reduced clicks to publishers’ articles. Google says publishers can opt out of AI Overviews without affecting search rankings.
Ives expects Alphabet’s free cash flow to bottom in the first half of 2027, improve later that year and rebound in 2028, with a substantial rise projected for 2029–2030.
Alphabet’s Google reported higher emissions, partly due to data center expansion, raising questions about its ability to meet long-term climate goals. Google did not comment.
Alphabet’s filing showed 3.0 million Qualcomm shares and 1.9 million Neutron Holdings shares at Sept. 30, 2026, compared with its holdings at June 30.
Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOGL) had disposed of its stakes in GitLab, Spero Therapeutics, and Autolus Therapeutics as of September 30, 2026, according to a filing.
